_meta.note: Care-team operating model for the AD pathways, modelled HYBRID human-in-the-loop: each human role keeps its clinical responsibilities; 'app_assist' is where the PureScore app/agent prepares, automates or signposts; 'escalates_to' is the handoff. The app never replaces clinical decisions — it surfaces, prioritises, nudges and escalates. Illustrative — NOT a clinical sign-off.

reception.title: Reception / front desk
reception.scope: First contact & visual triage (esp. mental health).
app_assist: Surface a pre-computed priority tier so booking is one tap

care_coordinator.title: Care Coordinator
care_coordinator.scope: Population search, invitation, engagement & behaviour change across ALL priorities.
responsibilities: Invite via SMS/telephone; explain the review
app_assist: Automated cohort search & risk stratification from the PureScore engine

nurse.title: Nurse
responsibilities: Record BP, weight, BMI, foot checks; arrange bloods if overdue
Teach home monitoring (BP, BM/CGM) & sick-day rules
app_assist: Auto-ingest home-BP / wearable / self-report into the record
Pre-populate the care plan from pathway templates

gp.title: General Practitioner (GP)
app_assist: Pre-computed score, trend, binding-constraint & provenance at point of care (Doc 03/05)
Flags out-of-date screening; surfaces canonical reference ranges

fm.title: Family Physician (FM)
responsibilities: Refer to specialist when indicated; complete post-referral actions
Allocate next review by control & risk
app_assist: Prioritised worklist (P1/P2 first) with the critical-marker cascade highlighted

dietitian.title: Dietitian
app_assist: Receives referral with diet history, activity & weight trend pre-attached

specialist.title: Specialist (nephrology / endocrinology / cardiology / lipid / weight / mental-health)
specialist.scope: Secondary care; assess then repatriate to primary care.
responsibilities: Repatriate to primary care with actions
app_assist: Structured referral packet (relevant markers, trends, meds, reconciliation status)
Repatriation actions flow back into the FM/GP worklist
